# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

[Meatless hybrid]

## The next step in meat innovation is hybrid

Combining Meatless^{®} ingredients with meat can improve taste and texture, reduce costs and add
nutritional value.

[DISCOVER THE BENEFITS][131]

## BENEO’s Sweet Box

Discover how BENEO’s Sweets Box brings confectionery innovation to life. Featuring concepts for hard
candies, chewing gum, gummies and cotton candy, it showcases the potential of Isomalt, Palatinose™
and functional fibres.

[Read more in our blog][139]

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

[Meatless hybrid]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**MOVE**

**NOURISH**

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

### Consistent Supply Chain


From certified organic farms through GMP-compliant manufacturing to 25 kg paper bags and 1,000 kg
FIBCs, we manage the full chain. No spot-market volatility, no undisclosed origin switching.

### Clean-Label Process


All enzymatic conversions and crystallization processes are carried out without acid hydrolysis,

label.

### Broad Format Range


Powder, liquid, granule, and syrup formats available across most product lines. Matching ingredient
form to your manufacturing process is part of the conversation from sample request onward.

# Ingredient distribution
# done differently.

## It's what's inside that counts.

### Looking for food ingredients? You’ve come to the right place. Whether you want to mix it up,
### stir the pot, dish it out, or just really like ingredient puns, Blendtek has you covered.

[Gummy bears in a pyramid on a black background.]

## Hi. We’re Blendtek.

Think of us as your new BFF*. We’re a food ingredients company 100% dedicated to making your
culinary creations utterly fabulous.

*best food forever

Ingredients

### Because the secret ingredient isn’t love.

From basics to beyond.

Our ingredient solutions range from the basics to the inspired; from salt and citric acid to plant
proteins, natural sweeteners and preservatives, functional food systems, and proprietary blends. 

[ Our Ingredients ][18]
[

Fun Fact: Pink peppercorns aren't actually peppercorns. They're called peppercorns because they’re
similar in shape and flavour to their namesake — these bright, tiny balls are nothing more than a
humble berry.

][19]
[A black and white image of a blueberry and a cinnamon stick.]
[A black background with berries and chocolate.]
[A black and white image of a dog with cinnamon sticks.]
[A man is riding a bike on a hill.]
Product Development

### Blend it like Blendtek.

Have a unique blend in mind?
From functional formulas to proprietary perfection, our blending facility and test-kitchen let us
expertly whisk up whatever your business needs.
[ Let's Create ][20]
[

Fun Fact: Thousands of years ago Gum Arabic, a popular ingredient in some of today’s fave treats,
was used in the ancient mummification process.

][21]
[A cup of bubble tea with macarons and a pink drink.]
[A yellow cupcake on a black background.]
[An ice cream cone with a scoop of ice cream.]

### Jack of all trades.
### Master of tons.

We don’t dabble in food ingredients, we dive right in.

Our laser (pewpew) focus helps us identify, source, deliver or blend the best ingredients with
unmatched fervour and knowledge. Our expertise stretches from bakery to beverages and everything in
between. Serving you pure culinary commitment – no distractions.

Case Studies

##### We’re the supply to your demand.

In the ever-shifting world of supply and demand, we never skip a beat. With a vast network of
partners, we pivot like culinary ninjas. Global crisis? No sweat. We keep your ingredients flowing,
no matter the twist.
[ Case Studies ][41]
[Colorful sprinkled donuts on a black background.]

###### The secret ingredient to supply chain challenges.

In the midst of post-COVID supply chain challenges, Blendtek was able to overcome the unexpected
recipe changes, poor communication, late deliveries and fluctuating prices a bakery was having with
their previous supplier.
[ View ][42]
[Chocolate cupcakes with bacon and icing.]

###### A collaborative partnership that’s the icing on the cake.

When a busy industrial bakery was being let down by their cake mix supplier, Blendtek was there to
provide the bespoke service, quality products and reliable supply to get things back on track.
[ View ][43]
[A group of beverage cans are arranged on a black background.]

###### Wrapping up one beverage distributor’s packaging spend & carbon footprint.

By reducing the number of rolls of hand wrap by 24% and cutting down the weight of plastic from
machine wrap by 31%, Blendtek’s high-performance film proved to be a win-win for the company and the
planet.

[ Ibogaine ][51]
`C20H26N2O` · 83-74-9
Ibogaine — naturally occurring indole alkaloid from the West African shrub Tabernanthe iboga, long
used outside the US to interrupt opioid use disorder in a single multi-day dose. Stanford's
30-veteran study (Cherian et al., Nature Medicine 2024) paired ibogaine with magnesium to mitigate
QT prolongation and reported one-month reductions of 88% in PTSD, 87% in depression, and 81% in
anxiety symptoms in special-operations veterans with traumatic brain injury. On 18 April 2026, with
Joe Rogan standing behind him in the Oval Office, President Trump signed "Accelerating Medical
Treatments for Serious Mental Illness" — directing HHS to channel at least $50M to states developing
psychedelic programs and instructing the FDA + DEA to open a Right to Try pathway for ibogaine.
Rogan said he had texted the president about the molecule and got back "Sounds great! Do you want
FDA approval? Let's do it!" — the policy turn the field had been waiting on for two decades.

`C12H17N2O4P` · 520-52-5

candidate for FDA approval. Compass Pathways hit its primary endpoint in two Phase-3 trials of
synthetic COMP360 for treatment-resistant depression: COMP005 (June 2025, single 25 mg dose, MADRS
-3.6 vs placebo, p<0.001) and COMP006 (February 2026, two 25 mg doses, -3.8 vs 1 mg active
comparator at Week 6, 39% achieving meaningful response). In April 2026 the FDA granted COMP360 a
rolling NDA review and a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher — a 1-2 month review-clock pathway
that could deliver the first FDA-approved psychedelic by 2027.

psilocybin to FDA ↗ ][58]

[ 3,4-Methylenedioxymethamphetamine ][63]
`C11H15NO2` · 42542-10-9
Midomafetamine (MDMA) - submitted to the FDA in 2024 as the first psychedelic to reach a PDUFA
decision in modern history. The agency issued a Complete Response Letter on 9 August 2024 requesting
an additional Phase-3 trial despite Phase-3 data showing 67% of MDMA-arm participants no longer

the three picks - vouchers went instead to two psilocybin programs and Transcend Therapeutics'
methylone, leaving MDMA-AT in regulatory limbo while the rest of the field accelerates.

[ Semaglutide ][67]
`C187H291N45O59` · 910463-68-2
Semaglutide - long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist (Ozempic / Wegovy / Rybelsus) that reshaped weight
management and type-2 diabetes care. Pictured is the lipid-modified Lys26 side-chain - the C18 fatty
diacid plus γ-Glu/OEG2 spacer that gives semaglutide its multi-day half-life via albumin binding. On
28 January 2025 the FDA approved an additional Ozempic indication to reduce kidney-disease
progression and cardiovascular death (FLOW: 24% RR reduction). In early 2026 the FDA cleared the
Wegovy oral tablet (OASIS-4 Phase-3: 16.6% mean weight loss at 64 weeks vs 2.7% on placebo) - the
first oral GLP-1 for weight loss and Novo Nordisk's answer to needle-averse patients and the
pill-based competitors now entering the class.
[ Novo Nordisk: FDA approves oral Wegovy - first oral GLP-1 for weight loss ↗ ][68] [ AJMC: FDA
approves oral semaglutide as first GLP-1 pill for weight loss ↗ ][69] [ FDA Ozempic kidney + CV
label (Jan 2025) ↗ ][70]
[ Caffeine ][71]
`C8H10N4O2` · 58-08-2
The world's most-consumed psychoactive compound - a methylxanthine adenosine-receptor antagonist
found in coffee, tea, and cocoa. Zhang et al. (JAMA, 2026) followed 130,000 Nurses' Health Study and
Health Professionals Follow-Up participants for up to 43 years and found 2-3 cups/day of caffeinated
coffee was associated with an 18% lower dementia risk and slower cognitive decline; the effect
survived adjustment for the APOE4 risk allele, while decaffeinated coffee showed no equivalent
benefit - pointing at caffeine itself as the active factor.
[ JAMA: Zhang et al. - Coffee/tea intake, dementia risk, cognitive function (2026) ↗ ][72] [ Nature:
Coffee linked to slower brain ageing in 130k-person study ↗ ][73] [ Harvard Gazette: 2-3 cups of
coffee a day tied to lower dementia risk ↗ ][74]
[ Aspirin ][75]
`C9H8O4` · 50-78-2
Acetylsalicylic acid - the first mass-produced synthetic drug (Bayer, 1899) and an irreversible
covalent inhibitor of cyclooxygenase via acetylation of COX-1 Ser530. After a century as the
canonical analgesic, low-dose aspirin remains a workhorse of secondary cardiovascular prevention;
primary-prevention guidance has tightened. A March 2026 meta-analysis from West China Hospital of
Sichuan University (10 RCTs, 124,837 participants) found no meaningful reduction in colorectal
cancer or precursor lesions among average-risk adults, reinforcing the USPSTF 2022 reversal and the
broader shift toward precision prevention rather than population-wide prophylaxis.

recommendation - aspirin for CVD prevention ↗ ][77]

Midomafetamine (MDMA) - submitted to the FDA in 2024 as the first psychedelic to reach a PDUFA
decision in modern history. The agency issued a Complete Response Letter on 9 August 2024 requesting
an additional Phase-3 trial despite Phase-3 data showing 67% of MDMA-arm participants no longer

progression and cardiovascular death (FLOW: 24% RR reduction). In early 2026 the FDA cleared the
Wegovy oral tablet (OASIS-4 Phase-3: 16.6% mean weight loss at 64 weeks vs 2.7% on placebo) - the
first oral GLP-1 for weight loss and Novo Nordisk's answer to needle-averse patients and the
pill-based competitors now entering the class.

found in coffee, tea, and cocoa. Zhang et al. (JAMA, 2026) followed 130,000 Nurses' Health Study and

coffee was associated with an 18% lower dementia risk and slower cognitive decline; the effect
survived adjustment for the APOE4 risk allele, while decaffeinated coffee showed no equivalent

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and

1. How to get samples for testing, sample cost and shipping method.

Most of products MOQ in one container, individual products can provide quantity of no less than one

## Who We Are

Gulshan Polyols Ltd is India’s leading manufacturers of Ethanol/Bio-fuel, Grain and Mineral based
specialty products with three decades of experience. Our business portfolio broadly spans across
three main segments, viz. grain processing, bio-fuel / distillery and mineral processing operations
that allow us to produce specialty products such as starch and starch derivatives including
sorbitol, calcium carbonate, ethanol (bio-fuel), country liquor, agro based animal feed.

GPL has accelerated its expansion plan in both existing and new geographies, emphasizing growth
potential in the Indian bio-ethanol space. Our theme - Expanding Potential, underpins our focus
strategies and demonstrates our commitment to a sustainable tomorrow.

manufacturer in the field of Bulk Drugs / Chemicals & Solvents / Veterinary & Feed Supplements.

**JC** established in the year 2002 with a focus on quality, commitment and delivery. We have
charted our way to success in our operation and have won the trust & admiration of our customers.

**JC** is founded by team of professionals with more than 30 yrs combined experience of design,
manufacturing, project management, and marketing in the leading local & multinational cos of above
field.

After serving the pharma companies & with all the expertise / relation we are all set to play a role
as an catalyst between the formulator & the marketing companies to get manufacture the product as
per the current compliance and deliver the goods as per the requirement

**VISION:** JC focus is to provide total customer satisfaction & to achieve leadership in the chosen
market, product & service across the globe, through excellence & technology. We will maintain a high
ethical standard in our practice.

**MISSION****:** Jigchem mission is to gain credibility which is known by the factors of
Competitiveness and Reliability. Its mission is also to ensure transparency in each business
transaction along with being a dutiful citizen towards environment.
** ****
****INFRASTRUCTURE:** We have a contemporary office which is fully furnished office, laced with
top-notch communication systems. It is located in the middle of market, allowing us to meet client's
demands timely and efficiently. We have our own warehousing facility situated at Bhiwandi for
storage of material.

**QUALITY ASSURANCE:** We appreciate that maintaining quality standard is a must in every
manufacturing / commercial activity. Therefore we procure our materials from well established ISO
9000 co.s of high reputed customers are provided with specification, samples / COA / MSDS etc as and
when required for efficiently handling the material at plant level. Request for third party
verification ( CSGS / GEO / Nikasu Lab etc ) are gladly accepted. Special attention is paid to
packaging & Transportation to ensure safe delivery without any hassle.

**CLIENT SATISFACTION:** For the last six years we have always placed our customer's interest before
our own. We strive to deliver high quality goods at a competitive price and maintain tight delivery
schedule. Our customers vouch for our transparent and fair dealings and appreciate our sense of
commitment in them. Our clientele is vast and reliable, which is a testimony of our regular growth.

### About Us

#### A Leader in Clay Mineral Product Innovation

With over 15 years of experience in the development and production of clay mineral products, Jiangsu
Hemings New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise located in Jiangsu Province,
covering an area of approximately 23.1 acres. We specialize in the research, development,
production, and trading of clay mineral products, including lithium magnesium sodium salt series,
magnesium aluminum silicate series, and various types of bentonite. Our company also offers
commissioned custom processing services.

With an annual production capacity of 15,000 tons, we are committed to innovation and quality. Our
registered trademarks, "HATORITE®" and "HEMINGS®" have become globally recognized brands, known for
their excellence both domestically and internationally.

## Your Success is Our Mission

Partner with KEY FOOD SUPPORT and experience the benefits of working with a trusted leader in the
global food ingredient market.

## KEY FOOD SUPPORT specializes in sourcing and supplying high-quality ingredients tailored to the
## unique demands of the food industry.

With a global network of trusted partners and suppliers, we ensure that your business has access to
the finest raw materials, ensuring consistency, innovation, and safety across your product range.

## Why choose KEY FOOD SUPPORT?

## Global Expertise

With operations across Europe and beyond, we bring the world’s best ingredients directly to your
production line, empowering you to stay ahead in a competitive market.

## Quality Assurance

Our rigorous quality control processes guarantee that every ingredient meets the highest industry
standards, ensuring reliability and peace of mind.

## Tailored Solutions

Whether you're seeking traditional ingredients or cutting-edge innovations, our expert team works
closely with you to deliver customized solutions that match your specific needs.

## We love food, we live food!

At KEY FOOD SUPPORT, we understand that in the world of food production, ingredients are key. That’s
why we’re dedicated to providing unparalleled service and support, ensuring you can focus on what
matters most — creating exceptional products that delight your customers.

## POTATO FLAKES - our best-selling product

[ [potato flakes] ][56]

flexibility**. By working with a network of trusted producers, we have the ability to scale and
diversify our offerings based on your exact specifications—something a single production line simply
cannot provide. Our wide range of products, along with the ability of selecting flake size, color,
ingredients, sugar content, and bulk density, makes us more than just a supplier – we are a true
partner in helping you develop your product.

Chromatography, with low investment, high separation efficiency, easy control and simple operation.

component group.

Membrane Filtration Technology

(including target products), salts and water are 100% permeated through microfiltration or
ultrafiltration membranes. Secondary ultrafiltration of the first permeating fluid is carried out if
necessary. Ultrafiltration technology can filter through to improve yield.

About the company

Neos Global is international company specializing in food segments and offers turn key solutions to
manufacturers from bakery, confectionery, sauces, Mayonnaise and other food sectors.

We are more than just a supplier of ingredients, as each of our project covers a variety of business
dimensions. NEOS GLOBAL provides consulting services, organize excursion to production facilities in
order to participate in pilot production activities, offering inhouse experience in cutting down
production cost.

For several years now, we have been distilling our experience, knowledge and traditions in
proprietary developments. We are convinced that our recognition is your success that can be well
cooked.

[#]

PRODUCTION

The RUSSKIYE INGREDIENTY plant is our in-house production complex of 1,800+ m2 located in the Moscow
Region. At our production facilities, we strictly comply with all sanitary and process standards for
the production of food ingredients.

Our high-quality ingredients are the result of continuous research by chemical technologists from
our in-house laboratory. They are studying the properties and characteristics of the component base,
as well as carrying out quality control of the products to be shipped.

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

## Welcome to Runshine (Foshan) New Materials Co.,Ltd

Runshine（Foshan ）New Materials Co.,Ltd is located in Foshan city of Guangdong province ,is famous
as hometown of Chinese coatings,near by Guangzhou. Runshine is mainly specialized in R&D,
manufacture and sale of different types of PU, UV and acrylic resins, additives, architectural
coatings, wood coatings, industrial coatings, adhesives and inks, which are widely used in civil and
industrial fields. It has two production bases in Guangdong province. Both are ISO9001 and ISO14001
certified. The annul production capacity of resin can reach 50,000 tons and 80,000 tons for coating
and ink products. So far, it has got over 30 patents in resins and coatings. Among its business
partners, there are PPG, Nippon, Henkel, Valspa, Sherwin-Williams, D-BASF, etc. Based on success in
domestic market, it started export business since 2019. Its products have been exported to Asia,
Europe, Africa and South America and the quality has been well accepted by the local customers. It
will continue to provide premium quality products and all-round service to customers from all over
the world.

[НОВЫЙ ЗАВОД РУСТАРК ПО ПРОИЗВОДСТВУ МОДИФИЦИРОВАННЫХ КРАХМАЛОВ][17]

первом этапе — при выборе сырья.


25.06.2026

основе полисахаридного сырья – углеводная кормовая добавка «MultyFeed».

## About Us

 

We are one of the major manufacturers of plant based speciality products and ingredient solutions in
India for food, animal nutrition and other industrial applications, with an installed capacity of
1,100 metric tons per day. Through complex, multi-step value addition and manufacturing process, we
turn maize into ingredients and solutions that add taste, texture, nutrients and increased
functionality to (i) foods as ingredients, thickening agents, stabilizers, sweeteners, emulsifiers
and additives in food products (bakery products, confectionery, pastas, soups, ketchups, sauces,
creams, deserts, amongst others), (ii) animal nutrition products as nutritional ingredients, and
(iii) other industrial products as disintegrants, excipients, supplements, coating agents, binders,
smoothing & flattering agents, finishing agents, among others.

 

We are the third largest manufacturer of maize based speciality products and ingredient solutions in
India. Our products include liquid glucose, dried glucose solids, maltodextrin powder, dextrose
monohydrate, native starches, modified starches and co-products like germs, gluten, fiber and
enriched protein, amongst others. Our speciality products and ingredient solutions are produced at
our large-volume, state of the art, strategically located manufacturing facilities at Dhule in
Maharashtra and Kutch in Gujarat. We believe that our leading position in the industry, technical
knowledge to bring specific functionality and nutrition to end products, more than five decades of
experience, state of the art manufacturing facilities, diverse product portfolio and clientele in
domestic and global markets, provide us with competitive advantage.

## About Us

 

We are one of the major manufacturers of plant based speciality products and ingredient solutions in
India for food, animal nutrition and other industrial applications, with an installed capacity of
1,100 metric tons per day. Through complex, multi-step value addition and manufacturing process, we
turn maize into ingredients and solutions that add taste, texture, nutrients and increased
functionality to (i) foods as ingredients, thickening agents, stabilizers, sweeteners, emulsifiers
and additives in food products (bakery products, confectionery, pastas, soups, ketchups, sauces,
creams, deserts, amongst others), (ii) animal nutrition products as nutritional ingredients, and
(iii) other industrial products as disintegrants, excipients, supplements, coating agents, binders,
smoothing & flattering agents, finishing agents, among others.

 

We are the third largest manufacturer of maize based speciality products and ingredient solutions in
India. Our products include liquid glucose, dried glucose solids, maltodextrin powder, dextrose
monohydrate, native starches, modified starches and co-products like germs, gluten, fiber and
enriched protein, amongst others. Our speciality products and ingredient solutions are produced at
our large-volume, state of the art, strategically located manufacturing facilities at Dhule in
Maharashtra and Kutch in Gujarat. We believe that our leading position in the industry, technical
knowledge to bring specific functionality and nutrition to end products, more than five decades of
experience, state of the art manufacturing facilities, diverse product portfolio and clientele in
domestic and global markets, provide us with competitive advantage.

We are dedicated to the society with excellent products, and strive to make new contributions to the
health of the people.

### Food Additives

][68]

Sinoright has a professional team that works closely with manufacturing partners to assure customers
of quality.
 
Among the large sum of choices, Sinoright is the premier provider of supply chain solutions for
the food and beverage making enterprises.
 
We have a wide range of scale which covered sweetener, acidity agent, thickener and so on.  

Products: sodium saccharin, citric acid, dextrose...
 

[learn more][69]

[Veterinary]

### Veterinary

][70]

Sinoright has established a solid cooperative relationship with major veterinary manufacturers in
China.

Classification of this field covers hundreds of raw materials such as treatment, prevention,
insecticide, killing, nutrition, feed additives and so on.The varieties can basically guarantee the
needs of customers.
 
As Sinoright continues to grow and develop, it will continue to provide more safe, efficient and
high-quality products for the industry, and contribute to the development of veterinary raw
materials.

### Specialty Chemicals

][72]


To catch up with the rapid growth of manufacturing industry, speciality chemicals are being used in
thousands of areas.
 
The company has established a professional team, responsible for the maintenance and development of
chemical products business.
 
Thanks to their hard-working, Sinoright can guarantee to meet the customers’ requirements.

][74]

Sinoright takes quality as the life of enterprise development, the cornerstone of customer’s
recognition, the only condition for market access. 

For customers who require dyestuff intermediates, Sinoright offers the assurance that we can provide
well-established expertise in working with these products.
 

Our products sell well all over the world and are favored by our customers.

][76]

Agrochemical is necessary in agrifulture production. In many countries, the use of agrochemicals is
strictly regulated.

Government licenses may be rrequired for the purchase and use of approved agricultural.

Sinoright has accumulated rich experience in exporting such products. We pay enough attention to
every request from our customers or their governments.

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry

# Pastry as Art

[3I6A9998-Edit.jpg]

[Birthday cakes in Marbella][20]

[27265658_10215432858999363_1650863727_o.jpg]

[Catering and Wedding cakes][21]

[3I6A9964-Edit-Edit.jpg]

[Cake Boutique at Art Bakery & Gourmet][22]

### Tanya Novak

### **My Journey in Pastry Excellence**

I am Tanya Novak, and I am delighted to share my journey in the world of pastry with you. My passion
for creating exquisite pastries began at **Le Cordon Bleu culinary school**, where I had the
privilege of learning from the finest French pastry chefs. This experience ignited my dedication to
the art of pastry making.

My career flourished with training at renowned establishments such as the **Michelin Star restaurant
J’AIME by Jean-Michel Lorain** in Bangkok and **Maxim’s restaurant**. These experiences allowed me
to refine my skills and explore innovative techniques and flavors. Furthering my expertise, I
attended the **Callebaut Chocolate Academy in Belgium** and participated in numerous pastry training
programs and competitions worldwide.

As a **pastry instructor**, I have shared my extensive knowledge with aspiring chefs in countries
including China, Thailand, Austria, Poland, Spain, Romania, and Germany. This role has been
incredibly rewarding, as I have witnessed my students grow and succeed in their culinary endeavors.

Today, I am the proud co-owner of **Art Bakery & Gourmet in Marbella**, Spain. In less than two
years, our bakery has gained **recognition as one of the top 10 most beautiful cafes** in Spain and
one of the best breakfast spots on the Costa del Sol. This success is a testament to our commitment
to quality and excellence.

**Each cake I create is crafted with the utmost care, using only the finest ingredients and
techniques honed over years of experience. Whether for a birthday, wedding, or any special occasion,
my creations are designed to delight your senses and create unforgettable memories.**

Join me on this sweet journey and experience the exceptional quality and artistry of my pastries.
Stay tuned for more delicious updates from Art Bakery & Gourmet.

Warm regards,

Tanya Novak

Professional Pastry Chef and co-owner of Art Bakery & Gourmet, Marbella

### MY EXPERIENCES MADE ME

## THE PROFESSIONAL I AM TODAY

Due to the fact that pastry is my number one passion, I have been in this industry for most of my
life and had a chance to experience all it has to offer. I have catered in different countries,
worked in Michelin-star restaurants, taught the art of pastry in kitchens all over the world, and
finally opened my own bakery. By being exposed to so many different working environments, I have
become an organized, efficient, and ambitious pastry chef. It has become important for me to always
reach for perfection while remaining patient and determined at all times. I also constantly research
new techniques and ideas to improve my creations and to get inspired for new recipes; most
importantly, I strive to balance different flavors together to create a natural sweetness and to
bring creativity, freshness, and originality to my work. When I call myself a professional pastry
chef, I am prepared to live up to this calling and provide you with your order of the best quality.

# "
# Tanya carries a very good working attitude, is highly self-motivated, and helpful, She shares Her
# thought and constantly looks for ways to improve the quality of the standards.

## Global Tianjia

With years of development in the global food and beverage industry, Tianjiachem, as one leading
manufacturer with our own flavor production line, plant protein production line, and creatine
production line, specializes in delivering not just premium ingredients, but also **“More Healthy,
More Tasty”** ODM & OEM solutions certified by **ISO9001, ISO22000, FDA, GMP, Kosher, and HALAL**,
to help global end-products manufacturers move forward in their target markets with less production
cost and higher efficiency. In addition to three production lines mentioned before, we also provide
many other products portfolios including natural herbal extracts, pure amino acids, vitamins,
natural sweeteners, etc.

No matter you are one food & beverage manufacturer or one functional food & beverage manufacturer,
or one nutritional supplements manufacturer who is looking for premium quality ingredients or
flexible formulations and ODM OEM services for your end-products productions, welcome to partner
with us to empower your business in your target markets.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

## [Nutrition Therapy for Chronic Critical Illness][158]

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

Patients with chronic critical illness face profound nutrition challenges after the ICU. Targeted
nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.
